title: NEXT F Event Registry
description: Authoritative canonical domain Event Registry. Events describe completed facts and remain independent of webhook/transport implementation.

categories.label: Event Foundation
categories.description: Envelope, producer, consumer, correlation, ordering, idempotency, retention and data-policy contracts.

categories.label: Site
categories.description: Site lifecycle and technical connection facts.

categories.label: Content & Publishing
categories.description: Structured content, media, navigation and publication lifecycle facts.

categories.label: SEO
categories.description: SEO configuration, redirect and sitemap operational facts.

categories.label: Forms & Leads
categories.description: Accepted submissions, Leads, assignments, status and consent records.

categories.label: Orders
categories.description: Order creation, state, financial and fulfillment reconciliation facts.

categories.label: Inventory
categories.description: Inventory reservations, adjustments, transfers and stock threshold facts.

categories.label: Fulfillment & Returns
categories.description: Fulfillment, shipment, delivery and return lifecycle facts.

categories.label: Commerce Customers & Reviews
categories.description: Commerce Customer and product review facts.

categories.label: Marketing
categories.description: Authoritative conversion and consent-state business facts; separate from visitor tracking observations.

categories.label: Integrations
categories.description: External connection, synchronization and health facts.

categories.label: Webhooks
categories.description: Webhook endpoint, subscription, delivery and signing lifecycle facts. These events are never themselves webhook eligible.
